question: When did the Hockey wizard Major Dhyan Chand make his Olympic debut?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1928, Amsterdam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Major Dhyan Chand, known as the "Hockey Wizard," made his Olympic debut in the **1928 Amsterdam Games**.
 
• During the 1928 Olympics, the Indian hockey team won its first-ever **gold medal** in the sport.
 
• Dhyan Chand emerged as the tournament's top scorer, showcasing his exceptional skills and earning global recognition.
 
• The Indian hockey team defeated the Netherlands 3–0 in the finals, with Dhyan Chand scoring two goals.
 
• This victory marked the beginning of India's dominance in Olympic hockey, winning consecutive gold medals in 1928, 1932, and 1936.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand**:

 
 
• Born on 29 August 1905, Dhyan Chand is regarded as one of the greatest hockey players in history.
 
• His birthday, 29 August, is celebrated as **National Sports Day** in India.
 
• He was known for his incredible ball control and goal-scoring abilities, earning the nickname "The Wizard."
 
 
 
• **Indian Hockey's Dominance**:
 
 
• India won 8 gold medals in hockey between 1928 and 1980, the most by any country in the sport.
 
• India's victories in the 1928, 1932, and 1936 Olympics solidified its reputation as a hockey powerhouse.
 
 
 
• **1928 Amsterdam Olympics**:
 
 
• This was the first time hockey was introduced as an Olympic event after its absence in the 1924 Paris Olympics.
 
• The Indian team played five matches, scoring 29 goals and conceding none throughout the tournament.
 
 
 
• **Legacy of Dhyan Chand**:
 
 
• He inspired generations of hockey players and remains an enduring symbol of excellence in Indian sports.
 
• The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**, India's highest sporting honor, is named in his memory.
